description: Resolve or reopen a thread on an initiative's Discussion — the console's Resolve and Reopen control. Pass `resolved: true` to resolve, `false` to reopen. A comment that belongs to another initiative is refused and nothing changes. Requires `write` scope and an editor-capable key owner.

commentId.description: The comment (from anyforge_list_initiative_comments) whose thread to resolve or reopen.

resolved.description: true resolves the thread; false reopens it.

name: anyforge_resolve_initiative_comment
title: Resolve initiative comment
